seo.title: Burst Fade for Artesia, NM | Divinely Faded, Carlsbad
seo.description: Burst fades for Artesia, cut in Carlsbad about {{city:artesia.drive_min}} minutes south on US 285. Why the cut fits a young town, how the arc grows out, and how to book on Booksy.

paragraphs: The burst is the half-moon of bare skin that curves around the ear and fans out behind it, with the back of the head left fuller. My chair is in Carlsbad, not Artesia: {{city:artesia.drive_mi}} miles down {{city:artesia.route}}, about {{city:artesia.drive_min}} minutes door to door by OpenStreetMap routing.
If you're making that drive for this cut, here's what I'd want you to know before you book.

blocks.heading: Built for the styles Artesia wears.
paragraphs: Artesia has a median age of {{city:artesia.median_age}}, younger than Carlsbad's {{city:carlsbad.median_age}} (Census ACS 2023). I mention it because the burst rarely stands alone: it's the fade under curly tops, faux hawks and mullets, cuts that lean young. If that's the direction you're headed, a burst keeps weight at the nape where those shapes need it, and I can match the arc to however much length you're growing in back.

blocks.heading: The ear is the clock.
paragraphs: Hair right around the ear is cut the shortest, so that's where the burst starts to blur. The longer hair at the back barely changes between visits. At {{city:artesia.drive_min}} minutes each way, I'd rather you not guess: tell me how crisp you want the arc, and I'll suggest a gap that fits. Then grab that next slot on Booksy before you pull out of Carlsbad.

One more reason to keep the arc tight through summer: Artesia logs about {{city:artesia.days_100f}} days a year at 100°F or more (Open-Meteo, 2023–25), and bare skin around the ear is one less place for that heat to sit.

items.q: Is the drive from Artesia worth it for a burst fade?
items.a: That's your call. The trip is about {{city:artesia.drive_min}} minutes each way, and I book by appointment only, so you'll know your exact chair time before you leave.

items.q: Can I get a burst fade with a mullet in one visit?
items.a: Yes. The burst fade mullet is one haircut, booked as an Essential or a Signature depending on whether your beard needs work.

items.q: Will a burst show on straight hair?
items.a: It does, with a softer outline than on curls. I usually cut some texture into the top so it doesn't lie flat against the arc.

items.q: Where are photos of your burst fades?
items.a: On the burst fade page, from the ear and from behind.
